entries.name: Check data balance
entries.description: Check your remaining Airtel Nigeria data balance; *323# also shows your data expiry date.
instructions: Your data balance (and expiry date) is displayed.
entries.costNote: Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: View data bundles
entries.description: View all data bundles available on the Airtel Nigeria network.
instructions: Follow the menu to view and buy a data bundle.
entries.costNote: Bundle prices vary by plan. Standard USSD session charges may apply.

entries.name: Borrow airtime
entries.description: Borrow airtime from Airtel Nigeria when you run out, repaid on your next recharge.
entries.networkScope: Eligible Airtel Nigeria SIMs only; eligibility is decided by Airtel
instructions: Follow the menu options to select your preferred loan amount.
entries.costNote: Service fees apply and are shown during the session.

entries.name: Transfer airtime
entries.description: Transfer airtime to another Airtel Nigeria number.
entries.networkScope: Airtel Nigeria to Airtel Nigeria only
instructions: Follow the menu to transfer airtime to another Airtel number.
entries.costNote: Transfer limits and fees are set by Airtel.

entries.name: Recharge airtime or data from your bank
entries.description: Buy Airtel Nigeria airtime or data directly from a linked bank account or debit card.
entries.networkScope: Airtel Nigeria lines linked to a bank account or with a debit card
instructions: Select the service you want: recharge for self or buy data bundles.
Choose payment through your bank or a debit card.
entries.costNote: Airtel states *444# is free to use; bundle and airtime prices still apply.

entries.name: Check my tariff plan
entries.description: See which Airtel Nigeria tariff plan your line is on.
entries.costNote: Standard USSD session charges may apply.

notice: Each verified entry records the operator page used for the last check. MTN Nigeria, Glo, and 9mobile are not yet covered: their official pages were unreachable during the last research pass. USSD menus can change by SIM, plan, device, or date; re-check with the operator if a code no longer matches.
